decision_rule: Pass only if M2849 audits M2848 artifacts under the unchanged actor and claim boundaries without new execution or overclaiming.
failure_criteria: M2849 runs new training validation ranking promotion or success-rate verdict computation
M2849 hides M2848 gate failures or weakens actor/claim boundaries
M2849 claims repair success driver performance validation readiness/result high-fidelity validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim verdict full ideal driver completion or self-ID result
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank checkpoints controllers source families task families profiles stress axes or scenario roles
do not replace any baseline checkpoint
do not compute success-rate verdict metrics
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not hide M2838 weak diagnostic outcomes
do not claim repair success driver performance validation readiness/result high-fidelity validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim verdict full ideal driver completion or self-ID result
hypothesis: A bounded result audit can accept or reject M2848 bounded continuation-preflight artifacts before any interpretation.

blocked_by: M2849 must audit M2848 summary status gates artifact completeness checkpoint lineage and claim boundaries
M2849 must keep M2838 weak diagnostic rows visible and outside performance denominators
M2849 must not promote the M2848 checkpoint or claim validation driver performance paper current-sim high-fidelity full-driver or self-ID evidence
parent_objective: audit M2848 bounded response-predictive recurrent-belief continuation artifacts before interpretation

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits new executable continuation-preflight artifacts from M2848
must_synthesize_if: M2848 response targets require hidden/oracle fields
M2848 cannot write proof generalization promotion rows
M2848 claims validation readiness driver performance paper current-sim high-fidelity or self-ID evidence
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: no paper verdict; audit governs Route A engineering training continuation

public_gates: M2849 must audit whether M2848 wrote complete continuation-preflight artifacts
M2849 must verify actor 72/action 3 and no hidden/oracle actor input were preserved
M2849 must verify response target schema includes only observation indices 0-8 and excludes previous-command fields from targets
M2849 must verify parameter trace shows recurrent/fusion or response-prediction mutation and rejects actor_mean.bias-only continuation
M2849 must verify proof generalization promotion actor claim and gate rows before any next training decision
M2849 must not validate rank promote compute success-rate verdict claim performance paper current-sim high-fidelity full-driver or self-ID result

allowed_claims: M2848 bounded continuation preflight accepted or rejected
no driver-performance verdict paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU result current-sim verdict high-fidelity validation result full ideal driver completion or level3 self-identification claim
self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2849 audits continuation preflight only and does not run finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID tests.
history_necessity_tests: Hidden intervention rows from M2848 are diagnostic artifact rows only and cannot support a self-ID claim.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If M2848 failed, preserve the negative continuation evidence and route to repair design, freeze, or stop rather than weakening gates.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2848 continuation artifacts plus M2838 weak diagnostic accounting.

success_criteria: audit checks M2848 summary checkpoint manifest parameter trace response target schema and gate rows
audit preserves actor 72/action 3 no hidden/oracle labels M2838 diagnostic boundary and claim boundary
audit registers one bounded follow-up route if continuing

admission_evidence: M2848 summary artifact is expected before M2849 runs
M2848 checkpoint manifest parameter trace response target schema and gate rows require audit before interpretation
allowed_updates: M2849 status queue scoreboard and review
one bounded follow-up manifest if audit accepts a next route
blocked_shortcuts: no new training or validation in result audit
no ranking winner selection promotion or success-rate verdict
no driver-performance paper current-sim high-fidelity full ideal driver or self-ID claim
next_stage_criteria: M2848 status and gate rows are accepted or rejected
failure types are classified if any gate failed
one bounded next route or stop is registered
training_stage.stage_objective: audit M2848 response-predictive recurrent-belief bounded continuation artifacts

workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: Result audit only; no validation ranking winner selection promotion success-rate verdict driver-performance paper current-sim high-fidelity validation self-ID or full ideal driver claim
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M2848 bounded continuation-preflight artifacts before any interpretation or further training
fallback_plan: route to implementation repair design only if a narrow artifact or runner issue is identified
route to bounded follow-up training design only if M2848 passes and audit admits more training evidence
route to limited-baseline freeze or branch stop if continuation cannot change evidence safely
stop_condition: stop if response targets include hidden/oracle fields or previous-command target leakage
stop if parameter trace is actor_mean.bias-only
stop if proof generalization promotion rows are incomplete
stop if M2848 claims validation readiness driver performance paper current-sim high-fidelity or self-ID evidence
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2848 continuation preflight has produced executable artifacts requiring audit
